title: AI Advertising Agencies That Actually Use AI to Make Creative
summary: Compare AI advertising agencies that make the creative with AI, not just edit it. See which publish AI production, human checks and prices, as of October 2026.
body_markdown:
Knowlify, Admiral Media, Airpost, CreatStrat, Creatify Studio and Pinprick publish AI-made production, where generated presenters, footage, animation or voice form the finished ad and people review it. Knowlify is our top pick because it makes all three of its formats with AI, delivers about 25 finished ads a week and has a person check every ad. In AI-assisted production, which describes NewForm and part of Superside's range, people shoot, animate or write, and AI speeds up editing, resizing or voiceover. Knowlify publishes this guide and sells one of the services compared, and we sit in the AI-made group.


The list below uses only what each agency publishes, as of October 2026. We did not test any agency's output, so treat the groupings as a starting point for your own review. For a broader list, see[Best AI Video Ad Agencies for Paid Social](https://knowlify.com/articles/best-ai-video-ad-agencies) , and for how to vet an agency, see[How to Vet an AI Ad Agency](https://knowlify.com/articles/ai-advertising-agency) .


## What counts as AI making the creative?


Use three questions to sort an agency. What does the AI generate in the finished ad: the presenter, the footage, the voice, the animation or only the cut? Which step does a person own? And what can the buyer see before launch?


Agency Where AI makes the creative Human check (as published) Published price


Knowlify ([AI UGC ads](https://knowlify.com/ai-ugc-ads) ) AI UGC presenters, character animation and AI commercials A person checks every ad before delivery From $5,000 a month


[Admiral Media](https://admiral.media/ai-ugc-agency/) AI presenters with multiple personas in talking-head videos Human editing and quality review €10,000 for 20 ads up to 15 seconds


[Airpost](https://www.airpost.ai/pricing) Dedicated AI video team with a custom model for your brand An editor for copy and voiceover From $6,000 a month


[CreatStrat](https://creatstrat.com/) AI presenters, AI video, statics and footage edits Not stated on its page $299 a month for 5 ads a week


[Creatify Studio](https://creatify.ai/studio) Managed production with AI-written hooks and scripts AI plus human QA on every asset $100 to $200 per video, per its comparison table


[Pinprick](https://pinprick.io/ai-ugc-agency) AI runs production, from scripts and casting to editing and delivery Human creative directors read every frame Percentage of ad spend, rate not published


[Superside](https://www.superside.com/ai-excellence) Full AI, hybrid or human-only modes Not stated by mode, so ask which applies Subscriptions from a $15,000 monthly minimum on an annual term


[NewForm](https://www.newform.com/) Human-led, with AI tools supporting dubbing, voice and static images Human strategists, creators, producers and editors Custom scope and quote


## Knowlify: our top pick for AI-made video ads


Knowlify fits this question because AI makes the creative in every format we sell: AI UGC with AI presenters talking to camera, 3D and stylized character animation, and AI commercials in a live-action style. About 25 finished ads come out each week, the first batch lands on day 5, and a person checks every ad before delivery, so AI-made does not mean unreviewed. You can add end-to-end Meta campaign management or take creative-only delivery if you have your own buyer. Pricing is a custom quote, and if the ads have not made more than you paid in the first 90 days, you can cancel by email for a full refund ([terms on the site](https://knowlify.com/meta-ads-agency#pricing) ). That 90-day refund applies to creative-only plans; where Knowlify runs the account, the guarantee is an agreed target in 30 days, or you don't pay for the month.


Pick another option if your ad needs a real creator's experience on camera, since our presenters are AI and not real customers or creators, or if you advertise outside Facebook and Instagram. An AI-made ad should never present an invented customer story as real.


## Which agencies make AI-led video ads?


### Admiral Media


Admiral Media sells AI UGC for app and ecommerce advertisers. Its AI presenters are finished with human editing and quality review. Starter costs €10,000 for 20 ads up to 15 seconds, Growth costs €16,000 for 40 ads up to 30 seconds and Pro costs €29,000 for 80 ads up to 60 seconds. Its page says ideal clients invest US$50,000 or more a month in paid media, and that AI UGC is scripted advertising, not content from a real customer.


### Airpost


Airpost pairs its platform with a dedicated AI video team, starting at $6,000 a month. It trains a custom model for your brand, delivers 10 to 100 or more video ads to test in multiple styles, and uploads them to your Meta account. Contract length is not published.


### CreatStrat


CreatStrat prices by ads per week: $299 a month for 5 ads a week, $499 for 10 and $899 for 20. Plans are billed monthly with cancellation at any time. Formats include AI presenters talking to camera, cut with product B-roll. The page does not describe a revision policy or say whether a person reviews each ad, so ask before you buy.


### Creatify Studio


Creatify Studio assigns a creative strategist, and its team uses AI to write hooks and scripts and to produce full video ads. The page lists 25 to 100 or more videos a month with a 48-hour turnaround. It does not say whether Studio runs campaigns.


### Pinprick


Pinprick scripts, casts, produces, edits and delivers UGC-style ads, with AI running production. Its inclusions are scripts, captioned editing, unlimited paid usage rights and AI-disclosure metadata for Meta and TikTok. Eligible brands pay an agreed percentage of ad spend, and that rate is not published. Its agency page also headlines ten UGC ads for $2,000, with no conditions listed, so ask what that offer covers.
